# git_identity_allowlist.txt -- the test files that still run `git commit` without the
# shared identity (internal/testgit), held by TestNoTestCommitsWithoutTheSharedGitIdentity
# in internal/ci/git_identity_class_test.go (docs/SPEC-CI.md, "Tests this spec demands").
# One row: file count reason, the count the commit sites in the file that do not run
# under testgit. Each either names an identity of its own (`-c user.name`, its own
# GIT_AUTHOR_*, a repository config) or none at all and leans on the machine's global
# git config, which a hosted runner does not have (run 37344601638).
#
# Shrink-only: a file not listed, or a count that rises, is red; fixing a site means
# lowering its row in the same change. NOVA_CI_UPDATE=1 lowers counts and drops rows
# at zero; it never adds a row or raises a count.
# ceiling: 54
